name: nmap
summary: Network exploration tool and security / port scanner.
description: Nmap ("Network Mapper") is used for network discovery and vulnerability scanning. It inspects live hosts, open ports, running services, and OS versions.

options.description: TCP SYN scan (default stealth scan, requires root).
Probe open ports to determine service/version info.
Enable OS detection, version detection, script scanning, and traceroute.

examples.title: Comprehensive version scan on target IP
examples.output:
Starting Nmap 7.94 ( https://nmap.org )
PORT   STATE SERVICE VERSION
22/tcp open  ssh     OpenSSH 8.9p1
80/tcp open  http    nginx 1.18.0
examples.explanation: Runs default scripts (-sC), version detection (-sV), and aggressive timing (-T4).

useCases: Discovering open ports and outdated vulnerable software services
warnings: Scanning networks without explicit authorization is illegal and unethical.
